market_reason: A violent Nvidia-driven swing (a sharp sell-off last week, then a 31% Nvidia rebound and a Nasdaq gain of about 7% today) with rising Treasury yields and growing Fed rate-hike odds makes conditions volatile. The rebound itself reduces the immediate crisis risk.
market_headlines: Stocks surge in best day since 2025, adding trillions in value after Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia - NBC News
Stock market rebounds sharply after sell-off, Nvidia closes up more than 31% - ABC News - Breaking News, Latest News and Videos
US stocks surge and recover half of last week’s plunge after Jensen Huang returns as Nvidia’s CEO - AP News
summary: Stocks recovered about half of last week's plunge after Jensen Huang was reinstated as Nvidia CEO. Rate-hike odds are rising, yields are up, and oil is falling on supply recovery, so the news is volatile but not a crisis. No ETF has a specific new exposure that justifies a veto.
